mapper.select: select bbp.bill_pay_id as billPayId, date_format(bbp.payee_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as payeeDate, bbp.received_amount as receivedAmount, bbp.payee_user_id as payeeId, be.employee_name as payeeName from base_bill_pay bbp left join base_employee be on bbp.payee_user_id = user_id where bbp.bill_id = #{billId} order by bbp.payee_date desc
